theme.title: Courtside Curiosities
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: Dennis Rodman led the NBA in rebounding for how many seasons in a row?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He also led the NBA in rebounds per game for a record seven consecutive years and won five NBA championships.

funFacts.text: Rodman originally played small forward before reinventing himself as a relentless power forward.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rodman played at the small forward position in his early years before becoming a power forward

funFacts.text: His number was eventually retired by the Pistons, and he entered the Hall of Fame that same year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Pistons retired Rodman's No.

funFacts.text: The Worm even entered professional wrestling, joining Hulk Hogan's nWo faction.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He was a member of the nWo and fought alongside Hulk Hogan

questions.prompt: The chart shows three other Finals scoring games. How many points did Rick Barry score in Game 2 of the 1975 Finals?
questions.context: Golden State vs Washington · 1975 Finals · Game 2
questions.note: 36 points in a one-point Warriors win.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: led by 36 points from Rick Barry

funFacts.text: The Warriors had to play their home Finals games at the Cow Palace because Oakland Arena was booked for the Ice Follies.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Oakland facility being unavailable due to the Ice Follies

funFacts.text: Washington got a final chance in Game 2 with six seconds remaining but missed both shots.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Washington got the ball back with six seconds left but missed two shots

funFacts.text: Barry had previously played for the rival ABA before returning to the Warriors.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: briefly lost Rick Barry to the American Basketball Association

questions.prompt: Joakim Noah averaged 10.4 rebounds per game in 2010–11. How many did Dwight Howard average for the 2008–09 Magic?
questions.note: 13.8 rebounds a night from Orlando's dominant center.

Howard won Defensive Player of the Year and made the All-NBA First Team.
